ShortDescription.Value: Design and build editable parks and plazas with custom surfaces, asset mixes and precise placement rules.

Publish.LongDescription: ParkManager lets you draw park and plaza outlines, mark entrances, choose game assets and preview procedural layouts before building them as editable Cities: Skylines II entities.
Publish.ChangeLog: Build configurable parks and plazas. Includes plaza centerpiece and arrangement rules, editable five-slot furniture arrangements, selectable surfaces and fences, asset chooser fixes, working density controls, and improved placement previews.
